# Files taken from ESP-IDF

Copied or generated from Espressif's ESP-IDF (Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`), at the
revision in `REVISION`. They are checked in so a fresh clone builds without
fetching ESP-IDF.

| Here | From ESP-IDF |
|---|---|
| `ld/esp32c5.rom.ld`, `esp32c5.rom.libc.ld`, `esp32c5.rom.api.ld` | `components/esp_rom/esp32c5/ld/`, unmodified: addresses of functions in the chip's mask ROM |
| `../../gen/*.c3` | generated by `scripts/gen_soc.py` from `components/soc/esp32c5/register/soc/*_reg.h` |

`./init.sh --regen` fetches ESP-IDF again and refreshes all of the above.
